newsitem.title: USA: IVAX aims to teach safe use of terfenadine.
newsitem.headline: IVAX aims to teach safe use of terfenadine.

text.p: IVAX Corp on Monday said it would begin a campaign to educate doctors and patients about the safe use of terfenadine, responding to an FDA proposal to withdraw its approval the antihistamine.
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration said earlier it intended to withdraw its approval of Seldane, or terfenadine, and Seldane D, or terfenadine and pseudoephedrine, marketed by a Hoechst AG unit.
In January, IVAX said it received FDA approval for terfenadine, a generic version of Seldane.
The FDA also said it would withdraw approval of generic versions of precription antihistamine containing terfenadine.
The FDA said there were serious cardiac risks if terfenadine was not used properly.
The agency said its decision also reflected the recent approval of Allegra, which contains a chemical that offers the same benefits of terfenadine without the risks.
"Under the circumstances, we believe better education, not withdrawal of the drug, is the solution that best serves the interests of the health-care community," IVAX said.
